reviews.rights: Owner-requested original diagrams, attributed published aggregate values, or generated conceptual line artwork. Required original illustration inputs and exact edit prompt retained. No publisher figure or manuscript PDF copied; no new reuse license assigned.
reviews.privacy: Self-reviewed final and source artwork. Scientific labels and schematic subjects only; no participant photographs, credentials or machine paths. Final composite PNGs are one-bit black/white. Scenario characters and hardware are illustrative. Final exports rebuilt identically from consolidated sources.
